mapper.select: select count(1) from tb_executor te join tr_executor_user teu on te.id=teu.executor_id join tb_user tu on tu.id=teu.user_id join tr_user_role tur on tu.id=tur.user_id where tu.status=0 and te.type=1 and tur.role_id=#{roleId}
select count(1) from tr_user_role tur where tur.role_id = #{roleId}
